what_this_is: A digest so a researcher does not have to read 232 KB of findings files before cutting its first face. placed_by_block is who each earlier run already has a portrait for; do not redo them. rejected is who has had a frame withdrawn, with the reason cut short. Read the full findings file only for somebody you actually intend to work on.
